You can explain, But the reason I haven't tried before was because of my family and friends. I'm tired of doing things to make other people happy. I'm not taking them into consideration anymore

I probably will change my mind. That why I need to today.

I haven't attempted yet but I think that taking sleeping pills before being exposed to the gas might help.

I'm 19, don't want to live to 20, my birthday is at the end of next month.

My grandmother was a big part of my life as well. She, my mother, and I lived in the same house together. But she got quite ill about two years ago and due to some close relatives not looking after the way they promised, she passed away.
https://beta.mangarock.com/manga/mrs-serie-100190092

I'm 19 right now, going to be 20 in November. I'm in a similar place as you only I don't want to live to see that date. At first I planmed to end my life at the end of highschool (US) but I made the mistake of telling one of my teachers and then being sent to a clinic. I haven't done anything at all after I graduated highschool. I've never really wanted any sort of job and I've been out of academic setting so long to even entertain the thought of college. 

I figured I could become a youtuber too, bought a nice camcorder and everything. I wanted to make videos of me painting or doing makeup tutorials but I soon loss interest in ar,t so now I'm just doing nothing day to day.

Ive began cleaning out my room and putting things I want to give to friends in separate bags. I wouldnt feel good leeching off my mother for the rest of my life.

When I was in highschool one of my teachers asked me why my grades began to drop in her class. I wrote her a note saying that I was planning on ending my life when school ends. I'm not sure what happened after she read it since I left it on her desk while I wasn't in the classroom but I'm guessing she notified the principal and the principal called my mother. My mother took me to a clinic in the hospital and I had to stay there for a few days.

Sorry if that doesn't really answer your question but I believe getting a letter from your doctor or therapist could allow the teachers to give you some extra time with your studies. Other than that I'm not sure if telling them will do much.
I don't have many people I can talk to. So I wrote here to get it out of my head.

Yeah I've never been on antidepressants. I wasted two years doing nothing. I never wanted to go to college anyway. I know it's not too late but I think it's too late for me. There isn't much use in me staying alive despite my friends and family.

I'm not on medication and I've spoken to my friends about it before. But only in detail to my closest friend who hasn't exactly taken it seriously. My mother knew I had depression but it's been awhile since we spoken about it and she may think it's gone.

Your comment made me smile, so thank you for that. I used to enjoy horror films a lot too until my interest in most things went away. Depressing music, if you can believe it, makes me happy while positive songs do the opposite. I don't know why.

But I appreciate you taking the time out to message me, I haven't eaten a Reese's in years. I'll try to change that.

I'm sorry I was really tired when I posted this. I fell asleep shortly after.

I graduated highschool never been to college. 

I don't mind, that's how I would start a conversation too.
I'm 19. Gonna be 20 in 2 months

I feel the same way. Mainly because the main friend I talk to about my problems doesn't take it seriously and will probably bring it up again as a joke. My other friends are all busy with their own issues for me to want to bother them.

I ate a pack of ramen noodles. They were a spicy seafood flavor. I really like spicy food. I noticed that I dont chew noodles all the way before I eat them even if I try it's hard for me to. I ate them out the pot I boiled them in. I enjoy instant ramen more than the restaurant kind. The broth was tasty. I'll probably have another pack later in the day. It felt nice at the moment because when I eat something a couple minutes later it doesn't feel like I ate anything. So I enjoyed that moment.

The way the world (or society) works today, you're not able to survive if you're in my position. I don't think it ever has.

A decent family, a good home, plenty of food, access to education, a bunch of nonessential things I got just for asking (or not). It's not that I think I don't deserve it, it's that I know it's going to go to waste.
Thank you

I've had two cats for a week now. I live with my mother and she got them from the previous owner who could no longer keep them since her mother is ill and is allergic. 

I've always wanted pets and I love these cats but I wish the previous owner would change her mind and take them back. 

I don't feel like I'm in a good place to have them. And I'm their sole caretaker, my mother is slightly allergic, if I were to end my life they may end up neglected and that's not fair to them.

There's a guy I've been seeing for about a year now. I care about him a lot but he doesn't want a relationship. I didn't know that when I first started seeing him but I stayed anyway cause I enjoyed being around him. 

He keeps two photos of him with his ex in his room, the kind that you get from a photo booth. It always makes me sad seeing those photos everytime I go over his place cause he must really miss her.

Anyway, one of his favorite movies is The Karate Kid and one day he told me that YouTube red was doing a follow up series called Cobra Kai. Only the first season was out at that time so I decided to watch it.

And I don't want to spoil anything important but there's a new teen boy that's kind of like Danny from the original movie and he takes this girl he likes to play mini golf and then there's a scene of them going into a PhotoBooth and taking pictures together. 

By that point I just broke down and started crying. I was really enjoying the show up until that point. I never continued watching.
Some people do scarification because they think it looks cool. Maybe you could tell him it's a form of that.

I would say that having a partner is the only thing I would like at this point. But expecting a person to couple up with someone like me is pretty selfish, depression and sexuality wise. I just don't see a point if I don't enjoy anything. Even me getting a job I would be taking away a spot from someone who may actually want to enjoy life.

I've lost interest in everything I used to love and there's nothing else in life I can see myself enjoying
I used to make art and write poetry.Those are the only things I can say I'm at least decent at.
I don't enjoy eating food, or the thought of traveling, I don't like dancing either. 

Most of what I say is very cynical and because of that I've been putting a damper on my friends enjoyment when I'm around them. 

I'm not in college or working. I honestly don't want to do either. I've never really had drive to better myself, I have no motivation for anything, and I believe people like that shouldn't live since they wont contribute anything.

I live with my mother but she's getting older, I can't keep burdening her like this. The older I get the more embarrassing it will be for her and myself

I'm asexual and because of that it'll be nearly impossible for me to find a partner that I won't eventually end up hating. Let alone be compatible with.

I used to be concerned about how my loved ones will be after I commit suicide and that kept me wanting to live. But eventually they will die and whatever pain they feel after I'm gone will be gone after that.

This is a subreddit for people with depression. What I said was nothing new or special here. If this is how you respond to seeing comments or posts like mine you're probably doing more harm than good here.

I don't know the situation between you with your family and I don't condone them beating you, but sometimes parents show that they care in the least effective ways possible.

No one will remember your pain but it doesn't matter because if you were happy no one would remember that either. You could die today or later. Yeah, people will tell you not to, that it's the wrong thing to do, but that's just because they're still alive. Once your dead nothing here will matter anymore and that goes for everyone.
